title: Excel Charts
description: Test your knowledge of creating and customizing charts in Excel

questions.question: Which chart type is best for showing trends over time?
questions.explanation: Line charts are ideal for displaying trends over time.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the 'Chart Title' in an Excel chart?
options: To describe the chart's purpose or content
questions.explanation: The chart title provides a brief description of what the chart represents.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a chart element?
questions.explanation: The Formula Bar is not a chart element; it is part of the Excel interface for editing cell contents.

questions.question: How do you add data labels to a chart?
options: Drag the labels from the worksheet onto the chart
Go to the 'Formulas' tab and click 'Insert Function'
Right-click the data series and select 'Add Data Labels'
questions.explanation: Data labels can be added by right-clicking the data series and selecting 'Add Data Labels'.

questions.question: Which chart type is used to show proportions of a whole?
questions.explanation: Pie charts are used to show how parts contribute to the whole.

questions.question: What does the 'Legend' in a chart represent?
options: A key to the colors or patterns used in the chart
questions.explanation: The legend explains the colors, patterns, or symbols used in the chart.

questions.question: Which tab in Excel is used to customize chart elements?
questions.explanation: The 'Chart Design' tab provides tools for customizing chart elements.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a 'Scatter Plot'?
options: To show parts of a whole
To show the relationship between two variables
questions.explanation: Scatter plots are used to visualize the relationship between two numerical variables.

questions.question: How do you change the chart type in Excel?
options: Go to the 'Home' tab and click 'Format'
Right-click the chart and select 'Change Chart Type'
questions.explanation: The chart type can be changed by right-clicking the chart and selecting 'Change Chart Type'.

questions.question: Which of the following is a 3D chart type in Excel?
questions.explanation: 3D Column Chart is a 3D visualization option in Excel.
